scenarios.name: Inspect properties of an inactive document from its tab

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/quick-access-toolbar/PartOne.opd` and `fixtures/cad/quick-access-toolbar/PartTwo.opd` are open in that order
the second part has been saved
the user opens the second part's document tab context menu
the first part remains active in the workspace
the user chooses Properties from the context menu
the properties dialog identifies the second part
its General page displays the file name, location, size and timestamps
the user closes the properties dialog without making changes
the first part remains active in the workspace
